## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when one exists.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their outcomes. Explain any relevant checks you could not run. Documentation-only changes need link and command review plus a whitespace check.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe effects on stored data, frozen experiments, task versions, adapter contracts, or budgets when relevant. For interface changes, include a screenshot or recording using original fixtures. State the scope of any quality, cost, or latency evidence.

Remove sections that do not apply.

- [ ] The change includes relevant documentation and behavioral verification.
- [ ] The diff and attachments contain no credentials, private repositories, hidden customer checks, model traces, workspace databases, or machine-specific settings.
